text_block_list.text:
A few days after Inari One began resting 
at the dorms, the locals threw a festival 
wishing for her recovery and invited her 
to join them.

After receiving encouragement from the 
folks back at Oi, Inari One realized that 
in caring so much about everyone, she had 
become consumed only with thoughts of 
winning.

This fight is mine, and I'm the one who's 
gonna take the top spot.

Then unless the person throwing the 
festival enjoys it first and fights her 
own battle, it's all meaningless. Inari 
One had forgotten that.

And so, having regained her groove, Inari 
One set out once more to make the Arima 
Kinen the greatest festival of all.
